name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: At Iris Lake, Shael'dryn entrusts you with Dartol's Rod of Transformation, restored for Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. You carry it back to report success and honor Teronis, the fallen scout.

sections.title: The Rod Restored
sections.body: Dartol's Rod of Transformation has been reforged with components and ancient gem fragments gathered from corrupted reaches of Ashenvale. Near Iris Lake, the dryad Shael'dryn cleanses and renews its magic, then sends you across the forest roads to Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner awaits the restored artifact.

sections.title: Honoring Teronis
sections.body: Teronis began the search for Dartol's rod, hoping it would slow the furbolg attacks on his people. A longtime friend of Raene, he died atop the island in Lake Falathim, cut down by murlocs who had taken the gem he sought. Bringing the restored rod to Raene marks a bittersweet victory, and gives purpose to the sacrifice Teronis never lived to see fulfilled.

faq.q: What is Dartol's Rod of Transformation?
faq.answer: Dartol's Rod of Transformation is a magical rod created by Dartol, a deceased evil wizard. Restored, it can aid Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks in Ashenvale.

Teronis was a young night elf sentinel Raene Wolfrunner tasked with finding components of ancient magic in Ashenvale. Murlocs took the gem he sought and killed him atop the island in Lake Falathim, leaving passing Alliance travelers to complete his mission.

Raene Wolfrunner is an experienced night elf sentinel commander in the heart of Astranaar. She oversees the defense of central Ashenvale against demonic taint, hostile satyrs, and corrupted local beasts.
Shael'dryn is a dryad who lives near the moonwell east of Iris Lake. Her knowledge of the forest and its ancient relics lets her purify corrupted relics and restore ancient tools of power.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You travel from the banks of Iris Lake in central Ashenvale west along the main trails to Astranaar, the zone's primary Alliance hub.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the rod to Raene?
faq.answer: Raene is relieved and proud that Teronis's final mission succeeded. Ashenvale's cleansing continues, and she seeks ways to use the rod's power against the woodland's persistent corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, carrying Teronis's legacy brings closure to Astranaar and shows that fallen kin are remembered amid rising threats to Kalimdor's sacred groves.
As an Alliance traveler, helping Raene Wolfrunner strengthens your standing among the reclusive Sentinels of Astranaar.
